old: A class of self-reliant smallholding agriculturalists.
new: A village economy begins with the household: seed kept for the next sowing, tools repaired through winter, and a harvest divided between sustenance and obligations. Peasant families could own their fields, rent them, or cultivate land under customary rights. Their circumstances varied widely, but their labor sustained towns, armies and courts far beyond the village. A good harvest offered security; crop failure, debt or heavy demands could consume the margin that kept a family independent.

old: A class of self-reliant smallholding agriculturalists.
new: L'économie villageoise commence au foyer : des semences gardées pour les prochaines semailles, des outils réparés pendant l'hiver et une récolte partagée entre subsistance et obligations. Les familles paysannes pouvaient posséder leurs champs, les louer ou les cultiver en vertu de droits coutumiers. Leurs conditions variaient beaucoup, mais leur travail nourrissait villes, armées et cours bien au-delà du village. Une bonne récolte apportait la sécurité ; de mauvaises récoltes, les dettes ou de lourdes charges pouvaient épuiser les réserves qui garantissaient leur indépendance.

old: A class of self-reliant smallholding agriculturalists.
new: Die Dorfwirtschaft beginnt im Haushalt: Saatgut für die nächste Aussaat, im Winter ausgebesserte Werkzeuge und eine Ernte, die für den eigenen Unterhalt und für Abgaben reichen muss. Bauernfamilien konnten ihre Felder besitzen, pachten oder nach überlieferten Nutzungsrechten bestellen. Ihre Lebensbedingungen waren sehr verschieden, doch ihre Arbeit ernährte Städte, Heere und Höfe weit über das Dorf hinaus. Eine gute Ernte schuf Sicherheit; Missernten, Schulden oder hohe Abgaben konnten die Rücklagen aufzehren, die einer Familie ihre Unabhängigkeit bewahrten.

old: A class of self-reliant smallholding agriculturalists.
new: L'economia del villaggio comincia in famiglia: sementi conservate per la prossima semina, attrezzi riparati durante l'inverno e un raccolto diviso tra sostentamento e obblighi. Le famiglie contadine potevano possedere i campi, affittarli o coltivarli in virtù di diritti consuetudinari. Le loro condizioni variavano molto, ma il loro lavoro sosteneva città, eserciti e corti ben oltre il villaggio. Un buon raccolto offriva sicurezza; carestie, debiti o tributi gravosi potevano esaurire le riserve che garantivano l'indipendenza di una famiglia.

old: A class of self-reliant smallholding agriculturalists.
new: La economía de una aldea comienza en el hogar: semillas guardadas para la siguiente siembra, herramientas reparadas durante el invierno y una cosecha repartida entre el sustento y las obligaciones. Las familias campesinas podían poseer sus campos, arrendarlos o cultivarlos conforme a derechos consuetudinarios. Sus condiciones variaban mucho, pero su trabajo sostenía ciudades, ejércitos y cortes mucho más allá de la aldea. Una buena cosecha ofrecía seguridad; las malas cosechas, las deudas o unas cargas excesivas podían agotar las reservas que mantenían la independencia familiar.

old: [TAB]When tribes met they often traded goods like furs to pottery, fish to deer meat etc. Trading goods eventually led to written language and mutually used currencies.
new: [TAB]At a river crossing or a seasonal gathering, goods could travel farther than the people who made them. Salt, grain, pottery and metal passed between communities with different resources and skills. Exchange took many forms, including gifts, credit, barter and, in some societies, money; these did not follow one universal sequence. As trade networks grew, merchants depended on trusted measures, protected routes and reliable partners. Along those routes traveled techniques, stories and beliefs as well as cargo.

old: [TAB]When tribes met they often traded goods like furs to pottery, fish to deer meat etc. Trading goods eventually led to written language and mutually used currencies.
new: [TAB]À un gué ou lors d'un rassemblement saisonnier, les marchandises pouvaient voyager plus loin que leurs fabricants. Sel, céréales, poteries et métaux circulaient entre des communautés aux ressources et aux savoir-faire différents. Les échanges prenaient diverses formes : dons, crédit, troc et, dans certaines sociétés, monnaie, sans suivre partout la même succession. Avec l'essor des réseaux commerciaux, les marchands avaient besoin de mesures fiables, de routes protégées et de partenaires dignes de confiance. Techniques, récits et croyances accompagnaient les cargaisons.

old: [TAB]When tribes met they often traded goods like furs to pottery, fish to deer meat etc. Trading goods eventually led to written language and mutually used currencies.
new: [TAB]An einer Flussfurt oder bei einem jahreszeitlichen Treffen konnten Waren weiter reisen als die Menschen, die sie herstellten. Salz, Getreide, Keramik und Metall wechselten zwischen Gemeinschaften mit unterschiedlichen Rohstoffen und Fertigkeiten. Der Austausch kannte viele Formen: Geschenke, Kredit, Tauschhandel und in manchen Gesellschaften Geld. Eine allgemeingültige Abfolge gab es nicht. Mit wachsenden Handelsnetzen wurden verlässliche Maße, geschützte Wege und vertrauenswürdige Partner wichtiger. Neben Waren verbreiteten sich auch Techniken, Geschichten und Glaubensvorstellungen.

old: [TAB]When tribes met they often traded goods like furs to pottery, fish to deer meat etc. Trading goods eventually led to written language and mutually used currencies.
new: [TAB]Presso un guado o durante un raduno stagionale, le merci potevano viaggiare più lontano di chi le produceva. Sale, cereali, ceramiche e metalli passavano tra comunità dotate di risorse e competenze diverse. Gli scambi assumevano molte forme: doni, credito, baratto e, in alcune società, denaro, senza seguire una sequenza universale. Con la crescita delle reti commerciali, i mercanti avevano bisogno di misure affidabili, percorsi protetti e soci fidati. Lungo quelle vie viaggiavano tecniche, racconti e credenze, oltre alle merci.

old: [TAB]When tribes met they often traded goods like furs to pottery, fish to deer meat etc. Trading goods eventually led to written language and mutually used currencies.
new: [TAB]En un vado o durante una reunión estacional, las mercancías podían viajar más lejos que quienes las producían. La sal, los cereales, la cerámica y los metales circulaban entre comunidades con distintos recursos y conocimientos. El intercambio adoptaba muchas formas: regalos, crédito, trueque y, en algunas sociedades, dinero, sin seguir una secuencia universal. Al crecer las redes comerciales, los mercaderes necesitaban medidas fiables, rutas protegidas y socios de confianza. Por esos caminos viajaban técnicas, relatos y creencias, además de mercancías.

old: [TAB]The School of Scribes is a place where people learn to read and write hieroglyphic and hieratic scripts.
new: [TAB]A reed pen, a clay tablet or a sheet of papyrus could turn a spoken obligation into a lasting record. In scribal schools, pupils practiced signs, copied model texts and learned the calculations needed to measure land, distribute rations and keep accounts. Traditions differed across societies: the scripts of Mesopotamia were not those of Egypt, and access to training was often restricted. Scribes served temples, palaces and merchants, preserving knowledge while giving institutions a memory longer than any single lifetime.

old: [TAB]The School of Scribes is a place where people learn to read and write hieroglyphic and hieratic scripts.
new: [TAB]Un calame, une tablette d'argile ou une feuille de papyrus pouvaient transformer un engagement oral en une trace durable. Dans les écoles de scribes, les élèves s'exerçaient aux signes, copiaient des modèles et apprenaient les calculs nécessaires pour mesurer les terres, répartir les rations et tenir les comptes. Les traditions variaient selon les sociétés : les écritures mésopotamiennes différaient de celles de l'Égypte, et l'accès à la formation était souvent restreint. Au service des temples, des palais et des marchands, les scribes conservaient le savoir et dotaient les institutions d'une mémoire dépassant une vie humaine.

old: [TAB]The School of Scribes is a place where people learn to read and write hieroglyphic and hieratic scripts.
new: [TAB]Ein Schreibrohr, eine Tontafel oder ein Blatt Papyrus konnte eine mündliche Verpflichtung dauerhaft festhalten. In Schreiberschulen übten Schüler Schriftzeichen, kopierten Vorlagen und lernten die Berechnungen für Landvermessung, Rationsverteilung und Buchführung. Die Traditionen unterschieden sich: Mesopotamien verwendete andere Schriften als Ägypten, und der Zugang zur Ausbildung war oft beschränkt. Schreiber dienten Tempeln, Palästen und Kaufleuten. Sie bewahrten Wissen und gaben ihren Institutionen ein Gedächtnis, das ein einzelnes Menschenleben überdauerte.

old: [TAB]The School of Scribes is a place where people learn to read and write hieroglyphic and hieratic scripts.
new: [TAB]Una penna di canna, una tavoletta d'argilla o un foglio di papiro potevano trasformare un impegno orale in una testimonianza duratura. Nelle scuole degli scribi, gli allievi si esercitavano con i segni, copiavano testi modello e imparavano i calcoli necessari per misurare i terreni, distribuire razioni e tenere i conti. Le tradizioni variavano: le scritture della Mesopotamia erano diverse da quelle egizie e l'accesso alla formazione era spesso limitato. Gli scribi servivano templi, palazzi e mercanti, conservando il sapere e dando alle istituzioni una memoria più lunga di una singola vita.

old: [TAB]The School of Scribes is a place where people learn to read and write hieroglyphic and hieratic scripts.
new: [TAB]Una pluma de caña, una tablilla de arcilla o una hoja de papiro podían convertir un compromiso oral en un registro duradero. En las escuelas de escribas, los alumnos practicaban signos, copiaban textos modelo y aprendían los cálculos necesarios para medir tierras, repartir raciones y llevar cuentas. Las tradiciones variaban: las escrituras de Mesopotamia no eran las de Egipto y el acceso a la formación solía estar restringido. Los escribas servían a templos, palacios y mercaderes, preservando el saber y dando a las instituciones una memoria más larga que una vida humana.

Where boats meet the road, a riverbank becomes a place of exchange. Boatmen unload grain, timber and stone; porters carry cargo to storehouses while merchants weigh goods and settle accounts. A river port links its town to settlements upstream and downstream, often moving heavy loads more cheaply than carts can. Its prosperity depends on navigable water, access to markets and the work of maintaining landings. Floods, silt and seasonal changes remind every trader that the river sets its own timetable.

Là où les bateaux rejoignent la route, la berge devient un lieu d'échange. Les bateliers déchargent céréales, bois et pierre ; les porteurs acheminent les cargaisons vers les entrepôts tandis que les marchands pèsent les biens et règlent leurs comptes. Un port fluvial relie sa ville aux localités en amont et en aval, transportant souvent les charges lourdes à moindre coût que les charrettes. Sa prospérité dépend de la navigation, de l'accès aux marchés et de l'entretien des débarcadères. Crues, alluvions et saisons rappellent que le fleuve impose son rythme.

Wo Boote auf Straßen treffen, wird das Flussufer zum Handelsplatz. Schiffer entladen Getreide, Holz und Stein; Träger bringen die Fracht in Lagerhäuser, während Kaufleute Waren wiegen und Rechnungen begleichen. Ein Flusshafen verbindet seine Stadt mit Siedlungen stromaufwärts und stromabwärts. Schwere Lasten lassen sich dabei oft günstiger befördern als mit Wagen. Sein Wohlstand hängt von schiffbarem Wasser, erreichbaren Märkten und gepflegten Anlegestellen ab. Hochwasser, Schlamm und wechselnde Jahreszeiten erinnern jeden Händler daran, dass der Fluss seinen eigenen Zeitplan hat.

Dove le barche incontrano la strada, la riva diventa un luogo di scambio. I barcaioli scaricano cereali, legname e pietra; i facchini portano le merci ai magazzini mentre i mercanti le pesano e regolano i conti. Un porto fluviale collega la città agli insediamenti a monte e a valle, trasportando spesso i carichi pesanti a un costo inferiore rispetto ai carri. La sua prosperità dipende dalla navigabilità, dall'accesso ai mercati e dalla manutenzione degli approdi. Piene, sedimenti e mutamenti stagionali ricordano ai mercanti che il fiume segue i propri ritmi.

Donde las barcas encuentran el camino, la ribera se convierte en un lugar de intercambio. Los barqueros descargan grano, madera y piedra; los porteadores llevan la carga a los almacenes mientras los mercaderes pesan las mercancías y ajustan las cuentas. Un puerto fluvial enlaza su ciudad con poblaciones río arriba y río abajo, a menudo transportando cargas pesadas a menor coste que las carretas. Su prosperidad depende de aguas navegables, mercados accesibles y embarcaderos bien cuidados. Las crecidas, los sedimentos y las estaciones recuerdan que el río impone su propio ritmo.

old: Sicker people, but a better economy.
new: Adds food and production to cottages and their later stages, but reduces their commerce. Favor this civic when growth and production matter more than the lost commerce; consider your research and treasury needs before adopting it.

old: Sicker people, but a better economy.
new: Augmente la nourriture et la production des cottages et de leurs évolutions, mais réduit leur commerce. Privilégiez ce principe lorsque la croissance et la production compensent cette perte ; évaluez les besoins de la recherche et du trésor avant de l'adopter.

old: Sicker people, but a better economy.
new: Erhöht Nahrung und Produktion von Hütten und ihren Ausbaustufen, senkt aber deren Kommerz. Diese Staatsform lohnt sich, wenn Wachstum und Produktion den entgangenen Kommerz aufwiegen. Berücksichtigt vor der Einführung den Bedarf von Forschung und Staatskasse.

old: Sicker people, but a better economy.
new: Aumenta il cibo e la produzione delle villette e delle loro evoluzioni, ma ne riduce il commercio. Favorisci questa forma di governo quando crescita e produzione compensano il commercio perso; valuta le necessità della ricerca e del tesoro prima di adottarla.

old: Sicker people, but a better economy.
new: Aumenta los alimentos y la producción de los caseríos y sus mejoras posteriores, pero reduce su comercio. Elige este principio cuando el crecimiento y la producción compensen el comercio perdido; considera las necesidades de investigación y del tesoro antes de adoptarlo.

old: This tech addes +1 trade route per city and allows Bazzar, Buchery and Silk Road as well as Trade Caravan units. It also enables barter system civic, which reduces the cost of cities and provides a commerces bonus. This technology leads the way for future commercial technologies.
new: Adds one trade route per city and enables Open Borders agreements. Connect cities to profitable trading partners to benefit from the extra capacity. Trade also opens paths toward Writing and Metal Casting.

old: This tech addes +1 trade route per city and allows Bazzar, Buchery and Silk Road as well as Trade Caravan units. It also enables barter system civic, which reduces the cost of cities and provides a commerces bonus. This technology leads the way for future commercial technologies.
new: Ajoute une route commerciale par ville et permet les accords de libre passage. Reliez vos villes à des partenaires commerciaux rentables pour profiter de cette capacité supplémentaire. Le commerce ouvre aussi la voie à l'écriture et au moulage du métal.

old: This tech addes +1 trade route per city and allows Bazzar, Buchery and Silk Road as well as Trade Caravan units. It also enables barter system civic, which reduces the cost of cities and provides a commerces bonus. This technology leads the way for future commercial technologies.
new: Ermöglicht einen zusätzlichen Handelsweg pro Stadt und Abkommen über offene Grenzen. Verbindet Städte mit ertragreichen Handelspartnern, um die zusätzliche Kapazität zu nutzen. Handel eröffnet außerdem Wege zur Schrift und zum Metallguss.

old: This tech addes +1 trade route per city and allows Bazzar, Buchery and Silk Road as well as Trade Caravan units. It also enables barter system civic, which reduces the cost of cities and provides a commerces bonus. This technology leads the way for future commercial technologies.
new: Aggiunge una rotta commerciale per città e permette gli accordi di Apertura delle frontiere. Collega le città a partner commerciali redditizi per sfruttare questa capacità aggiuntiva. Il commercio apre inoltre la strada alla Scrittura e alla Fusione del metallo.

old: This tech addes +1 trade route per city and allows Bazzar, Buchery and Silk Road as well as Trade Caravan units. It also enables barter system civic, which reduces the cost of cities and provides a commerces bonus. This technology leads the way for future commercial technologies.
new: Añade una ruta comercial por ciudad y permite acuerdos de Apertura de fronteras. Conecta las ciudades con socios comerciales rentables para aprovechar esa capacidad adicional. El comercio también abre caminos hacia la Escritura y la Fundición del metal.

old: Increases city's science output and generates some culture as well. Required before you can build Plato's Academy.
new: Increases research output by 15%, provides one scientist slot and produces culture. Most useful in cities with substantial research output. A Library replaces this building, so their research bonuses do not add together.

new: Augmente la recherche de 15 %, offre un emplacement de scientifique et produit de la culture. Particulièrement utile dans les villes dotées d'une recherche importante. Une bibliothèque remplace ce bâtiment : leurs bonus de recherche ne se cumulent pas.

old: Increases city's science output and generates some culture as well. Required before you can build Plato's Academy.
new: Erhöht die Forschung um 15 %, bietet einen Wissenschaftlerplatz und erzeugt Kultur. Besonders nützlich in Städten mit hoher Forschungsleistung. Eine Bibliothek ersetzt dieses Gebäude; ihre Forschungsboni werden nicht addiert.

old: Increases city's science output and generates some culture as well. Required before you can build Plato's Academy.
new: Aumenta la ricerca del 15%, offre uno spazio per uno scienziato e produce cultura. È particolarmente utile nelle città con una ricerca elevata. Una Biblioteca sostituisce questo edificio: i loro bonus alla ricerca non si sommano.

old: Increases city's science output and generates some culture as well. Required before you can build Plato's Academy.
new: Aumenta la investigación un 15%, ofrece un puesto de científico y produce cultura. Resulta especialmente útil en ciudades con una investigación elevada. Una Biblioteca sustituye este edificio, por lo que sus bonificaciones a la investigación no se suman.

old: Gives 20% bonus for trade routes. Can be built in cities which have access to river. Building Harbor in the same city disables this building.
new: Adds one trade route and increases trade route income by 20%. Requires a city on a river. A Harbor replaces this building, so compare the additional route capacity and trade bonus when deciding whether to upgrade.
